name: NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM)
description: Guidance on identifying, assessing, and mitigating cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain at all organizational levels, covering commercial software, foundation model vendors, and hardware.

requirements.title: Supply Chain Controls and Functional Performance
requirements.normalized_requirement: The organization establishes and enforces supply chain controls for suppliers of critical components, APIs, foundation models, and cloud infrastructure.
requirements.applicability: AI deployments relying on external vendors or hosted models
requirements.implementation_guidance: Perform periodic C-SCRM assessments on critical AI model providers (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure AI).
